doc: FBL 0.12, sections 5.2 and 6.3 (items), FR-025: etalii.adp.ide.standalone/src/diagrams/wardley-map/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Diagram.WardleyMap.Tests/Fixtures/annotations-and-labels.owm at ad1a4680a, unchanged. Annotation 1 is pinned at two positions, '[[0.43,0.49],[0.08,0.79]]', read as a list of two structured values, each a visibility and a maturity read from its position's two numbers; annotation 2's single bare position is a list of one. A set of one item's value is a replace-value of that value alone; an item added is an insert-key of the separator and the item's create.emit after the last item; an item removed is a remove-key of the item and the separator before it, or, for the first item, the one after it.
